caption: The drawing consists of a single, symmetrical brown shape outlined in black, resembling a cross-section of a boat or shallow vessel, positioned horizontally near the center of an off-white or light beige background. The brown shape curves smoothly upward at both ends, forming a shallow "U" shape, and there is a thin, straight black line connecting the highest points of the two upward curves, forming a horizontal line above the brown shape. The composition is minimalist, and there are no other objects or elements depicted, aside from a small, barely visible signature in the lower left corner and a faint impression or watermark in the lower right corner of the paper.
